The upgrade has been rescheduled: production cutover is now **Saturday December 5, 02:00–05:00 UTC**, approved by Maya, after the Fernhill go-live of Dec 1 [2]. The key dates from the ticket, which Noa says is the reference because the Notion runbook isn't updated yet: staging rehearsal Friday Nov 27, customer notice (status page + in-app banner) Saturday Nov 28, migration freeze from Thursday Dec 3 [2].

Note two contradictions with older sources: the runbook still shows "Saturday November 21, 02:00–05:00 UTC", freeze Nov 19, notice Nov 14 [1], and the #eng-announce post of Nov 3 says the same Nov 21 window [3] — the Nov 16/17 ticket supersedes both [2].

For the macro: the only thing I found is Rachel saying on Nov 3 she'd prepare "the customer notice and the support macro for the 14th" [3], i.e. tied to the old notice date. I searched for a newer macro date (queries around "support macro / status page / December 5", filtered to items since Nov 13) and read the Linear ticket KES-398, the runbook, and the #eng-announce thread — no updated macro date is recorded, so you'll need to confirm it with Rachel.
